title: The Michelin Inspector and Katya's Prank

scenes.title: Classical Music and News of the Inspector
scenes.summary: After Eleonora's classical-music team-building session, Louis reveals that his father's restaurant was visited by a Michelin inspector who may come to their restaurant next.

scenes.title: An Old Friend from Paris
scenes.summary: Katya's old Paris culinary-school friend Olivier checks into the hotel, and Eleonora and Barinov immediately suspect he is the undercover Michelin inspector.

scenes.title: Morning at Lyova's Home
scenes.summary: Lyova encourages nervous Gulya before her visit, and his mother Vera Ivanovna hints that she needs a woman's help with the housework.

scenes.title: Parental Paranoia
scenes.summary: Katya laughs at her parents' suspicion that Olivier is a Michelin inspector, since he was expelled from school for throwing poached eggs at the rector.

scenes.title: The Family Council and Forgotten Barberries
scenes.summary: Katya rejects her parents' request to spy on Olivier, and at Lyova's apartment Gulya realizes she forgot barberries for her pilaf and sends Lyova to the market.

scenes.title: Nikita's Ambitions
scenes.summary: Nikita brags that Mikhail is old and losing his grip and that he plans to take his job, unaware that Mikhail is standing right behind him.

scenes.title: Pills in the Trash
scenes.summary: Barinov's doctor catches him throwing away his prescribed heart pills and warns him that overworking will kill him, right before Katya enters.

scenes.title: The False Trail in the Notebook
scenes.summary: Katya claims Olivier has a notebook full of restaurant notes and complained about the heat in his room, prompting Eleonora to upgrade him to a suite and Barinov to call in Lyova.

scenes.title: Gulya Is Mistaken for a Housekeeper
scenes.summary: Katya tells Olivier to head down to the restaurant in half an hour, and at Lyova's apartment Vera Ivanovna mistakes Gulya for a hired maid.

scenes.title: The Inspector Comes Down to the Dining Room
scenes.summary: Olivier orders the wild pigeon and flounder galantine, and Barinov takes over the entire kitchen to prepare the meal himself.

scenes.title: Meeting Eleonora and Serving the Dish
scenes.summary: Olivier thanks Eleonora for upgrading him to the luxury suite, and Barinov personally serves his wild pigeon in ginger sauce.

scenes.title: Oversalted Pigeon and Denis's Revenge
scenes.summary: Olivier feels guilty pranking Barinov because the pigeon is delicious, but Katya tells Barinov that Olivier said it was oversalted; meanwhile Denis plots payback against Nikita.

scenes.title: Washing Windows and the Real Inspector's Photo
scenes.summary: Vera Ivanovna has Gulya wash the windows and offers to lend her to a neighbor, while Louis shows Barinov a photo of the real Michelin inspector.

scenes.title: Unmasking at the Table
scenes.summary: Barinov tells Olivier he knows he is the Michelin inspector, while Louis shows Katya the photo proving the real inspector is someone else.

scenes.title: Hot Sauce and Revenge for the Piano
scenes.summary: Barinov pours hot sauce into the galantine thinking Olivier is a fraud, while Denis tells Katya he put pepper spray on Nikita's napkin as payback for gluing the piano lid.

scenes.title: Chef's Collapse
scenes.summary: Chaos erupts in the dining room as both Olivier and Nikita get pepper in their eyes, and when Katya confesses her prank, Barinov collapses.

scenes.title: The Suspicious Neighbor
scenes.summary: After Gulya washes all the windows, Vera Ivanovna's friend warns her that quiet maids often steal money, and then asks to borrow five thousand rubles.

scenes.title: At the Hospital with the Chef
scenes.summary: The doctor asks Katya and Eleonora to make sure Barinov takes his medicine, and Eleonora tells Barinov that Lyova cooked for the real Michelin inspector.

scenes.title: Accusation of Theft
scenes.summary: Barinov's chefs visit him at the hospital, while at Lyova's apartment Vera Ivanovna and her friend accuse Gulya of stealing five thousand rubles and grab her bag.

scenes.title: Gulya Is My Girlfriend!
scenes.summary: Lyova clears Gulya's name by admitting he took the 5,000 rubles himself and introduces her as his girlfriend, though hurt Gulya walks out; meanwhile Katya tells Denis and Nikita that Olivier is her boyfriend.
